name: analyze_image
description: 👁️ Analyze images using AI vision. Understands photos, screenshots, documents, artwork. Accepts: URLs (https://...), local files (/path/to/image.jpg), stash references (stash://space_id/file_id). Use for: identifying objects, reading text in images, describing scenes, answering questions about visual content. Can optionally save web images to stash for future tool access.

image.description: Image source - URL (https://example.com/pic.jpg), local path (/home/user/photo.png, ~/images/pic.jpg), or stash reference (stash://space_id/file_id)

question.description: What to analyze or ask about the image. Examples: 'What objects are in this image?', 'Read the text', 'Describe the mood', 'Is there a cat?'. Default: general description.

stash_after.description: If true and image is from URL, download and save to stash for future access by other tools (email, print, canvas). Default: false
